title: Olympia Brass Band and other brass bands
summary: With Harold Dejan's Olympia since about 1963; occasional jobs with Eureka and Tuxedo.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So you've had a lot of experience. Well tell me about some of the brass bands you've played with here. You said Harold DeJones, Olympia.
Yeah, well I've been with Harold DeJones say about since 1963.
Have you been playing any other jobs occasionally with other brass bands?

Yeah, well I performed with, let's see, I performed with, performed through Eureka once. Eureka Brass Band. I performed with Andrew Morgan and Tuxedo a couple of times. And most of my job was with Olympia Brass Band, but like I said I have performed with these guys before.
And I've only performed twice with brass bands. I'm always with brass bands.
